title: Downloading data with vegbankr
text: package R client VegBank, vegetation plot database Ecological Society America’s Panel Vegetation Classification, hosted National Center Ecological Analysis Synthesis (NCEAS). VegBank contains vegetation plot data, community types recognized U.S. National Vegetation Classification others, ITIS/USDA plant taxa along taxa recorded plot records. VegBank API client, vegbankr package currently supports querying downloading vegetation plot records, addition validating uploading new data VegBank database.
